name: YEP! Youth Employment Program
org: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department
what_you_do: You get your first job at rec centers and parks. Areas include arts, sports, aquatics, gardening and cooking. Facility operations is another area.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 17 in San Francisco.
pay_detail: Pay not posted on the program page
duration: Up to 25 hours per week in summer; 10 hours per week in the school year
deadline_text: No dates posted. Fill out the interest form, or email the program to ask when the next round opens.
how_to_apply: Fill out the YEP! Interest Form. Questions: email yep@sfgov.org or call Yuri Ugarte at 415-452-3863.
notes: This page replaced the older Workreation name on the department site. An older listing says applicants need work-permit papers and no citizenship is required.
